related.title: OCI映像索引：平台描述與不可變主體鏈
related.titleEn: OCI image indexes: platform descriptors and immutable subject chains
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：58.333%與66.667%可重算，版本不符及under_investigation仍未排除；有效JSON不等於安全結論。 交付openvex-applicability.json、三類拒絕理由及未決清單；僅使用合成漏洞與產品名稱。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 58.333 and 66.667 percent, retain version mismatches and under_investigation as unsuppressed, and distinguish valid JSON from a supported security conclusion. Deliver openvex-applicability.json, rejection categories and an unresolved list, using only synthetic vulnerabilities and product names with no unsupported claims about real software safety.
related.difference: 建立10個部署描述，列要求OS、architecture、variant、索引摘要與實際選中manifest；另列未知平台與重複匹配順序反例。
related.differenceEn: Build ten deployment descriptors with required OS, architecture, variant, index digest and selected manifest. Include unsupported platforms and multiple matching entries, retaining their order rather than treating the index as an unordered dictionary.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地接受規則要求產品與子元件識別都符合、作者受信任且理由可查；格式有效只是輸入門檻，不等於not_affected內容已被獨立證實。 12筆發現中7筆有精確適用且理由已審查的聲明，3筆版本不符，2筆缺理由；三類互斥。 可採用聲明率7/12×100≈58.333%；補齊一筆原缺理由且識別符合者後為8/12×100≈66.667%。
本地准入要求平台契約符合且選中manifest摘要在已審查集合；tag只做顯示，不當穩定識別。索引摘要與子摘要各有不同範圍，不能互相代換。 10筆中8筆平台選擇正確，其中6筆子manifest摘要已核准；2筆平台錯誤即使摘要已知仍不通過。 完整准入率6/10×100=60%；為一筆正確平台補齊子manifest審查後變7/10×100=70%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Local acceptance requires matching product and subcomponent identities, a trusted author and reviewable rationale. Structural validity is only an input gate, not independent confirmation that a not_affected assertion is technically correct. Seven of 12 findings have exactly applicable statements with reviewed rationale, three have version mismatches and two lack adequate rationale. Make these categories disjoint so a single deficient statement is not subtracted twice. Usable statement coverage is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Completing rationale for one identity-matching case raises it to 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent, while version mismatches remain inapplicable.

The local gate requires platform compatibility and a selected manifest digest in the reviewed set. Tags remain display labels. Index and child-manifest digests identify different objects and cannot be substituted for one another in verification. Eight of ten deployments select the intended platform, and six of those use an approved child digest. Two platform-mismatched deployments remain rejected even if their digest appears elsewhere in an approved inventory. Full admission is 6/10×100=60 percent. Completing child-manifest review for one correctly selected platform yields 7/10×100=70 percent without changing the requested platform or the other descriptors.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Gatekeeper：參照式政策的同步資料與過期快取
related.titleEn: Gatekeeper: synchronized inventory and stale referential decisions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：58.333%與66.667%可重算，版本不符及under_investigation仍未排除；有效JSON不等於安全結論。 交付openvex-applicability.json、三類拒絕理由及未決清單；僅使用合成漏洞與產品名稱。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 58.333 and 66.667 percent, retain version mismatches and under_investigation as unsuppressed, and distinguish valid JSON from a supported security conclusion. Deliver openvex-applicability.json, rejection categories and an unresolved list, using only synthetic vulnerabilities and product names with no unsupported claims about real software safety.
related.difference: 建立20個應同步的namespace/物件描述，列來源版本、快取版本與查詢路徑；以同名標籤衝突模型測試缺資料與已同步資料。
related.differenceEn: Build 20 expected namespace/object descriptors with source revision, cached revision and inventory path. Use a duplicate-label model to compare absent data with synchronized data, recording cluster-scoped and namespaced paths separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本地接受規則要求產品與子元件識別都符合、作者受信任且理由可查；格式有效只是輸入門檻，不等於not_affected內容已被獨立證實。 12筆發現中7筆有精確適用且理由已審查的聲明，3筆版本不符，2筆缺理由；三類互斥。 可採用聲明率7/12×100≈58.333%；補齊一筆原缺理由且識別符合者後為8/12×100≈66.667%。
本課以已同步且版本符合物件數衡量覆蓋率；同步通常有延遲，100%當下覆蓋也不保證之後兩個並行准入不競爭。 20個預期物件中15個已進入正確inventory路徑且版本相符，5個缺失或過期；固定GVK與namespace範圍。 覆蓋率15/20×100=75%；補同步其中3個後為18/20×100=90%，另2個仍需保留未決。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Local acceptance requires matching product and subcomponent identities, a trusted author and reviewable rationale. Structural validity is only an input gate, not independent confirmation that a not_affected assertion is technically correct. Seven of 12 findings have exactly applicable statements with reviewed rationale, three have version mismatches and two lack adequate rationale. Make these categories disjoint so a single deficient statement is not subtracted twice. Usable statement coverage is 7/12×100, approximately 58.333 percent. Completing rationale for one identity-matching case raises it to 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent, while version mismatches remain inapplicable.

Measure coverage as objects synchronized at the expected revision. Synchronization has delay, and even full coverage at one instant does not prove that two subsequent concurrent admissions cannot race; this is an observation metric, not a transactional uniqueness guarantee. Fifteen of 20 expected objects occupy the correct inventory paths with matching revisions. Five are missing or stale. Fix the GVK and namespace scope so excluded kinds are not silently treated as successful synchronization. Coverage is 15/20×100=75 percent. Synchronizing three more gives 18/20×100=90 percent, leaving two unresolved; the increase does not establish a global freshness guarantee.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
